record_unit: evaluation/output view; not an independent learner, fit, game or player

definitions.mae: mean(abs(prediction - actual)); native target units; lower is better
definitions.mse: mean((prediction - actual)^2); squared target units; lower is better
definitions.rmse: sqrt(MSE); native target units; lower is better
definitions.bias: mean(prediction - actual); signed native target units
definitions.p90_abs: 90th percentile absolute error; source interpolation retained
definitions.p95_abs: 95th percentile absolute error; source interpolation retained
definitions.max_abs: maximum absolute error; native target units
definitions.brier: mean((event_probability - binary_actual)^2); lower is better, compare prevalence baseline
definitions.log_loss: mean(-log(probability assigned to observed binary event)); no percent accuracy conversion
definitions.nll: source-reported negative log score; inspect source support/normalization before comparison
definitions.crps: source-reported proper distribution score; inspect support and score definition
definitions.selection_loss_rate: losses/(wins+losses) for the declared selected-side threshold panel; decided statistical crossing error, not MAE or profit

precision_definition: exact/tolerance fractions only when explicitly supplied; numerator reconstructed from rate*n is labeled; probability residual precision is not binary accuracy
forbidden_accuracy_conversion: Native errors, software pass counts, and interval coverage are never converted to percent prediction accuracy.

comparison_reporting.delta: candidate error minus comparator error; negative favors candidate
comparison_reporting.relative: delta / comparator error; null when comparator is zero or matching is unestablished
comparison_reporting.matching: explicit retained-row binding required; equal sample counts alone are insufficient
comparison_reporting.unreported: UNESTABLISHED with reason; no generic percentage accuracy from error
comparison_reporting.projection: CSV annotations do not alter source scores, predictions or earlier index bytes

streaming_build.ordering: prior immutable shards followed by new registered versions; CSVfilterbytestID/panel

reader_contract: New reported/reproduced/reconstructed/future and software evidence retain distinct identities; a score view is not a fit or unique NFL observation.
csv_header_policy: Prior immutable CSV parts are reused; new product columns may extend the header. Combine by column name. JSON shards are authoritative.
category_csv_scope: New appended evaluation views only; use prior category CSVs and source rankings for earlier records.
